errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has a linear scale. However, the axis has no tick marks or scale markings, so stating the scale type is an assumption not directly supported by the visual evidence.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the y-axis scale ranges down to 60%. The axis scale is independent of the data; it is the data line that approaches the value of 60%. The axis itself does not have a defined range ending at 60%.
